Yuletide Boutique Holiday Market

Friday, Nov 20, 2026 10:00AM

Free Holiday Market
Yuletide Boutique
Opening Hours 10am–3pm

Celebrate the season at our free Yuletide Holiday Market, lovingly organized by the Montalvo Service Group (MSG). Browse unique gifts, handmade treasures, holiday décor, specialty foods from local vendors and vintage finds throughout Montalvo’s beautiful historic Villa while supporting this cherished tradition. Registration is free—please let us know you’re coming so we can plan accordingly. Free Parking.

incoming.title: Yuletide at Montalvo Pop-Up Holiday Boutique
incoming.address: Montalvo Arts Center, 15400 Montalvo Rd, Saratoga, CA 95070
incoming.description: Pop-up holiday boutique with gifts, handmade items, vintage goods, holiday décor and specialty foods from local vendors. Runs Friday, Nov 20 and Saturday, Nov 21; no times given.
